title: Finance AI Lead
description:
The Organisation

Nigel Wright Group is delighted to be working with a leading organisation to recruit a Finance AI Transformation Lead, an exciting opportunity for an experienced finance professional to play a major role in shaping how AI, automation and technology are used across the Finance function.

This is much more than a traditional AI or technology position. We’re looking for someone who understands how a complex Finance function actually operates and can identify where processes can be redesigned, automated and improved through the practical application of AI and modern technology.

It’s an opportunity to combine deep Finance knowledge with transformation, systems thinking and emerging technology to help create a more efficient, insightful and future-focused Finance function.



The Opportunity

The Finance AI Transformation Lead will work across the Finance function to identify where AI, automation and technology can make a meaningful difference to processes, controls and ways of working.

Rather than simply introducing new technology, you’ll take the time to understand how existing Finance processes operate, where inefficiencies or manual interventions exist, and how those processes can be redesigned before determining where AI and automation can add genuine value.

You’ll work across areas including FP&A, accounting and reporting, treasury, controls and broader Finance operations, helping to take opportunities from initial idea and process design through to implementation and adoption.

It’s a role that requires somebody who can comfortably bridge the gap between Finance, Technology and Transformation, combining strong financial knowledge with the ability to challenge existing ways of working and translate emerging technology into practical improvements.


What youll be doing

You’ll have a broad remit across Finance transformation, process improvement, AI and automation, including:

  • Working with Finance teams to understand and map existing processes, systems, controls and pain points.
  • Identifying and prioritising opportunities to use AI, automation and technology across Finance.
  • Redesigning Finance processes rather than simply automating existing ways of working.
  • Improving processes across areas such as FP&A, budgeting and forecasting, accounting and reporting, month-end, treasury, reconciliations and Finance operations.
  • Developing clear business cases for transformation initiatives, including expected efficiency, productivity and financial benefits.
  • Taking AI and automation opportunities from initial concept through to practical implementation.
  • Ensuring appropriate financial controls, reconciliations, governance and human oversight remain embedded within redesigned processes.
  • Working with Finance, Technology and other stakeholders to ensure new solutions integrate effectively with existing systems and data.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve management information, reporting and decision-making through better use of Finance data.
  • Supporting the adoption of new tools and ways of working across Finance teams.
  • Helping colleagues understand how AI can be used safely and effectively within their day-to-day roles.
  • Measuring the impact of transformation initiatives and ensuring they deliver tangible improvements to Finance operations.

About You

We’re looking for somebody who combines genuine Finance experience with transformation, systems and AI capability.

You may have progressed through roles such as Finance Director, Financial Controller, Head of FP&A, Finance Operations Lead or Finance Transformation Lead before becoming increasingly involved in digital transformation, automation and AI.

Alternatively, you may already work within Finance Transformation but have previously spent a significant part of your career working directly within an operational Finance function.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Significant experience working within a substantial or complex Finance function.
  • Strong understanding of core Finance processes, ideally spanning areas such as FP&A, accounting and reporting, treasury, financial controls and Finance operations.
  • Experience improving, redesigning or transforming Finance processes.
  • Practical experience applying AI, automation or digital technology within Finance.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, reconciliations, governance and audit requirements.
  • Experience working with enterprise Finance systems, data and reporting platforms.
  • Exposure to technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Power BI, GenAI, RPA or other AI and automation tools would be advantageous.
  • The ability to understand a Finance problem first and determine the right technology solution second.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the credibility to work effectively with senior Finance and Technology leaders.
  • A commercial mindset with the ability to identify and demonstrate measurable value from transformation initiatives.

We are particularly interested in people who started their careers in Finance and have subsequently developed strong transformation, systems, automation or AI experience.

This isn’t a role for a pure technologist who happens to have delivered solutions into Finance. The Finance knowledge is fundamental. You’ll need to understand the underlying processes, controls and requirements well enough to challenge them and determine how they should operate differently.
